nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token name 'Nimbus Wrapped Ether'.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol 'NWETH'.
Public uint8 state variable fixing the token decimal scaling at 18.
Public mapping tracking the ETH/token balance credited to each address; mutated by deposit, withdraw and transferFrom.
Public nested mapping storing spender allowances granted by token owners; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Payable receive() fallback that forwards all plain ETH transfers into deposit().
Public payable deposit() that credits msg.value to the caller balance and emits Deposit.
Public withdraw(uint wad) that debits caller balance, sends ETH via transfer and emits Withdrawal.
Public view totalSupply() returning the contract's ETH balance.
Public approve(address guy, uint wad) that overwrites the caller's allowance for a spender and emits Approval.
Public transfer(address dst, uint wad) that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
Public transferFrom(address src, address dst, uint wad) that validates balance and allowance then moves funds and emits Transfer.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner/spender and ETH recipient across the contract.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(wad) inside withdraw: external ETH delivery performed after the balance debit, a classic reentrancy-shaped interaction.
allowance[src][msg.sender] -= wad inside transferFrom: raw allowance arithmetic that must stay consistent with the prior require.
balanceOf[msg.sender].add(msg.value) inside deposit: arithmetic crediting caller-controlled msg.value into contract state.
Parameter wad of withdraw(uint wad): amount of ETH the caller requests to withdraw.
Parameter guy of approve(address guy, uint wad): spender address being granted an allowance.
Parameter wad of approve(address guy, uint wad): allowance amount written into the allowance mapping.
Parameter dst of transfer(address dst, uint wad): recipient address of the token movement.
Parameter wad of transfer(address dst, uint wad): amount forwarded to transferFrom.
Parameter src of transferFrom(address src, address dst, uint wad): account whose balance is debited.
Parameter dst of transferFrom(address src, address dst, uint wad): account whose balance is credited.
Parameter wad of transferFrom(address src, address dst, uint wad): amount moved between balances.

edges.reason: The receive() fallback unconditionally forwards every plain ETH transfer into deposit().
transfer() delegates the whole movement to transferFrom() using msg.sender as src.
withdraw() executes the external payable transfer to the caller after mutating balanceOf, forming an interaction-after-effect pattern.
deposit() credits msg.value into balanceOf through the add arithmetic operation.
transferFrom() decrements the allowance mapping with raw subtraction guarded only by the preceding require.
msg.sender is used as the key indexing balanceOf in deposit, withdraw and transfer.
msg.sender indexes both dimensions of allowance, so caller identity drives the authorization check.
deposit() attributes the credited balance to the caller-supplied msg.sender.
withdraw() resolves the debited balance and the ETH recipient directly from msg.sender.
transferFrom() compares src against msg.sender and reads allowance[src][msg.sender], making the caller the authorization subject.
msg.sender is the destination of the external ETH transfer inside withdraw, giving the caller control at the interaction point.
The wad parameter of withdraw() is the quantity subtracted from the caller balance.
The wad parameter of withdraw() directly determines the value of the outbound external ETH transfer.
The guy parameter of approve() becomes the spender key written into allowance.
The wad parameter of approve() is the allowance value granted to the spender.
The dst parameter of transfer() is propagated as the recipient of the delegated transferFrom call.
The wad parameter of transfer() is propagated as the amount of the delegated transferFrom call.
The src parameter of transferFrom() is the account whose balance and allowance are checked.
The dst parameter of transferFrom() is the credited balance key.
The wad parameter of transferFrom() is subtracted from src balance and from the allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: wad only exists to parameterize withdraw()'s balance debit and external transfer, so it collapses into the withdraw function node.
guy is the spender key used solely inside approve(), so it merges into the approve function node.
wad is only written into allowance by approve(), so it merges into the approve function node.
dst of transfer() is only forwarded to transferFrom, so it merges into the transfer function node.
wad of transfer() is only forwarded to transferFrom, so it merges into the transfer function node.
src is only consumed by transferFrom()'s balance and allowance checks, so it merges into the transferFrom function node.
dst is only used as the credited key inside transferFrom(), so it merges into the transferFrom function node.
wad is only used for the balance and allowance arithmetic of transferFrom(), so it merges into the transferFrom function node.
